title: Windows XP Error
blurb: The Windows XP error ding — the sound of something going wrong in 2003, permanently installed in the memory of everyone who grew up with a family computer. Microsoft hired Bill Brown to compose the XP sound set, aiming for warmth rather than alarm, which is why the error chime is oddly gentle for a message that usually meant the homework was gone. Today it's pure nostalgic comedy: play it when someone makes a mistake and watch an entire generation flinch in unison.
origin: The critical-error chime from Microsoft Windows XP (2001).
